name: Diphenylpyraline
summary: Diphenylpyraline is a first-generation antihistamine with anticholinergic effects of the diphenylpiperidine class. It is marketed in Europe for the treatment of allergies. DPP has also been found to act as a dopamine reuptake inhibitor and produces hyperactivity in rodents. It has been shown to be useful in the treatment of Parkinsonism.

pharmacology.text: Diphenylpyraline (DPP; sold as Allergen, Arbid, Belfene, Diafen, Hispril, Histyn, Lergobine, Lyssipol, Mepiben, Neargal) is a first-generation antihistamine with anticholinergic effects of the diphenylpiperidine class. DPP has also been found to act as a dopamine reuptake inhibitor and produces hyperactivity in rodents.

sideEffects.en: Like other first-generation antihistamines, it can cause drowsiness, dry mouth, blurred vision, constipation and difficulty passing urine. Large amounts can cause anticholinergic poisoning, with confusion, a racing heart and hallucinations.
sideEffects.zh: 與其他第一代抗組織胺一樣，二苯拉林可能造成嗜睡、口乾、視力模糊、便祕與排尿困難。大量使用可能引起抗膽鹼中毒，出現意識混亂、心跳急促與幻覺。
sideEffects.zhHans: 与其他第一代抗组织胺一样，二苯拉林可能造成嗜睡、口干、视力模糊、便秘与排尿困难。大量使用可能引起抗胆碱中毒，出现意识混乱、心跳急促与幻觉。

fact.en: It belongs to the same benzhydryl ether family as diphenhydramine, the antihistamine in Benadryl, which shares the same pair of phenyl rings on one carbon.
fact.zh: 二苯拉林與苯海拉明（Benadryl中的抗組織胺）同屬二苯甲基醚家族，兩者都有兩個苯環接在同一個碳原子上。
fact.zhHans: 二苯拉林与苯海拉明（Benadryl中的抗组织胺）同属二苯甲基醚家族，两者都有两个苯环接在同一个碳原子上。
